propositions: A ticket directory with no CREATE or SNAPSHOT event causes the plan-relation reducer to fail with reducer-error, surfacing as INDETERMINATE verdict on unrelated tickets in the same epic's relation graph.
Empty ticket directories created by incomplete writes are invisible to git and persist in local clones until manually removed, blocking all plan reviews in the affected epic.
The plan-relation snapshot reducer should tolerate event-less directories by skipping them with a warning instead of failing the entire snapshot, allowing reviews to proceed.

The writer creates ticket directories via os.makedirs before writing the first event; orphans result from process death during the staging-to-rename window and cannot be safely cleaned up without risking races under concurrent write access.
